title: Purple Mage Fighter
description: A young woman with white and purple hair stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-inspired outfit with a crown-like headpiece, wields glowing purple magical energy in both hands, one forming a circular sigil and the other emitting swirling particles.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian woman with long white hair tied in a topknot with purple streaks, wearing an ornate white and purple martial arts outfit with wide pants, a sash, and armored details. She has a spiky purple crown-like halo floating above her head. She is in a combat stance, one hand extended forward emitting swirling purple magical energy, the other hand holding a glowing purple circular sigil. Dramatic purple particle effects, clean digital painting style, solid gray background, sharp details, fantasy character design.
